Task 1 — Automated Inspection of a Document Under Uneven Lighting You are developing an automated document-scanning system for a university archive. A document was photographed using a mobile phone, but the lighting is not uniform: one side of the page is brighter than the other. The system must separate the printed text from the background . A single global threshold may produce missing characters in dark areas or unwanted regions in bright areas . Your Task Given the document image: Perform the following: 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. Load the image in grayscale. Apply global thresholding using threshold values . Compare the resulting binary masks. at least three different Apply adaptive thresholding to the same image.
